public_rationale: OpenAI's February 13, 2023 release notes describe performance and service changes without identifying a repair of Eisenberg's violence-related example [e1]. Research published May 23, 2023 reports a collection of 78 verified jailbreak prompts as of April 27, 2023 [e2]. These records do not establish the predicted sequence: repair of that specific anomaly, followed promptly by discovery of different jailbreaks [e1, e2]. They also do not establish the explanation that further jailbreaks arise because patches are invariably superficial [e1, e2]. The compound forecast remains unresolved [e1, e2].
limitations: The release notes do not verify the specific repair, but their silence does not show that no repair occurred [e1].
The collection date does not establish when each jailbreak was discovered relative to the proposed repair [e2].
Neither item provides a reproducible retest of Eisenberg's exact prompt or evidence of what a specific repair changed [e1, e2].
